headline: Executive order directs that drug cartels and similar groups be treated as foreign terrorist organizations under US law.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets out to label cartels and other organizations as Foreign Terrorist Organizations and Specially Designated Global Terrorists. These are legal labels the US government uses for terrorist groups. Such labels generally allow the government to freeze the groups' money in the US and make it a crime to give them support. No summary was provided, so the specific groups named and the exact steps required are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Drug cartels and other criminal organizations based outside the US
who_it_affects.how: Groups that receive these labels can face asset freezes and other penalties that apply to terrorist groups.

who_it_affects.group: People and businesses that deal with designated groups
who_it_affects.how: Giving money or other support to a designated group can bring criminal charges or financial penalties.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies such as the State and Treasury Departments
who_it_affects.how: They would handle the process of making and enforcing the designations.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 20, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the provided material.
